values.description: Meter reading at the end of an invoicing period where an actual reading is not available.

values.name: Employer's identification number
values.description: Number issued by an authority to identify an employer.

values.name: Embargo number
values.description: Number assigned to specific goods or a family of goods in a classification of embargo measures.

values.name: Export permit number
values.description: Reference number assigned by issuing authority to an export permit for products.

values.name: Equipment number
values.description: Number assigned by the manufacturer to specific equipment.

values.name: Container/equipment receipt number
values.description: Number of the Equipment Interchange Receipt issued for full or empty equipment received.

values.name: Exporter's reference number
values.description: Reference to a party exporting goods.

values.name: Excess transportation number
values.description: Number assigned to excess transport.

values.name: Export licence number
values.description: [1208] Reference number assigned by issuing authority to an Export Licence.

values.name: Fiscal number
values.description: Tax payer's number. Number assigned to individual persons as well as to corporates by a public institution; this number is different from the VAT registration number.

values.name: Freight forwarder's reference number
values.description: [1460] Reference number assigned to the consignment by the freight forwarder.

values.name: File line identifier
values.description: Number assigned by the file issuer or sender to identify a specific line.

values.name: Flow reference number
values.description: Number given to a usual sender which has regular expeditions of the same goods, to the same destination, defining all general conditions of the transport.

values.name: Freight bill number
values.description: Reference number assigned by issuing party to a freight bill.

values.name: Foreign exchange
values.description: Exchange of two currencies at an agreed rate.

values.name: Free zone identifier
values.description: Identifier to specify the territory of a State where any goods introduced are generally regarded, insofar as import duties and taxes are concerned, as being outside the Customs territory and are not subject to usual Customs control (CCC).

values.name: File version number
values.description: Number given to a version of an identified file.

values.name: Foreign exchange contract number
values.description: Reference number identifying a foreign exchange contract.

values.name: Standard's number
values.description: Number to identify a standardization description (e.g. ISO 9375).

values.name: Government contract number
values.description: Number assigned to a specific government/public contract.

values.name: Standard's code number
values.description: Number to identify a specific parameter within a standardization description (e.g. M5 for screws or DIN A4 for paper).

values.name: General declaration number
values.description: Number of the declaration of incoming goods out of a vessel.

values.name: Government reference number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Harmonised system number
values.description: Number specifying the goods classification under the Harmonised Commodity Description and Coding System of the Customs Co-operation Council (CCC).

values.name: House waybill number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a house waybill, see: 1001 = 703.

values.name: Internal vendor number
values.description: Number identifying the company-internal vending department/unit.

values.name: In bond number
values.description: Customs assigned number that is used to control the movement of imported cargo prior to its formal Customs clearing.

values.name: IATA cargo agent code number
values.description: Code issued by IATA identify each IATA Cargo Agent whose name is entered on the Cargo Agency List.

values.name: Initial sample inspection report number
values.description: Inspection report number given to the initial sample inspection.

values.name: Internal order number
values.description: Number assigned to an order for internal handling/follow up.

values.name: Intermediary broker
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Interchange number new
values.description: Number assigned by the interchange sender to identify one specific interchange. This number points to the actual interchange.

values.name: Interchange number old
values.description: Number assigned by the interchange sender to identify one specific interchange. This number points to the previous interchange.

values.name: Import licence number
values.description: [1106] Reference number assigned by the issuing authority to an Import Licence.

values.name: Invoice number suffix
values.description: An invoice number add on to split for detailed specification purposes.

values.name: Internal customer number
values.description: Number assigned by a seller, supplier etc. to identify a customer within his enterprise.

values.name: Invoice number
values.description: [1334] Reference number assigned by the seller to a Commercial Invoice.

values.name: Job number
values.description: Identifies a piece of work.

values.name: Ending job sequence number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Loading authorization number
values.description: [4092] A number assigned to the loading authorization granted by the forwarding station when the consignment is subject to traffic limitations (CIM 43).

values.name: Lower article number of range
values.description: Lower serial number in a range for declaration of incoming goods.

values.name: Lockbox
values.description: Type of cash management system offered by financial institutions to provide for collection of customers 'receivables'.

values.name: Letter of credit number
values.description: Reference number identifying the letter of credit document.

values.name: Line item reference number
values.description: (1156) Reference number identifying a particular line in a document.

values.name: Master bill of lading number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a master bill of lading, see: 1001 = 704.

values.name: Manufacturer's part number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the manufacturer to his product or part.

values.name: Meter unit number
values.description: Number identifying a unique meter unit.

values.name: Manufacturing order number
values.description: Reference number assigned by manufacturer for a given production quantity of products.

values.name: Mailing reference number
values.description: Identifies the party designated by the importer to receive certain customs correspondence in lieu of its being mailed directly to the importer.

values.name: Manufacturer's material safety data sheet number
Master air waybill number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a master air waybill, see: 1001 = 741.

values.name: North American hazardous goods classification number
values.description: Reference to materials designated as hazardous for purposes of transportation in North American commerce.

values.name: Current invoice number
values.description: Reference number identifying the current invoice.

values.name: Previous invoice number
values.description: Reference number identifying a previously issued invoice.

values.name: Order number (purchase)
values.description: [1022] Reference number assigned by the buyer to an order.

values.name: Original purchase order
values.description: Reference to the order previously sent.

values.name: General order number
values.description: Customs number assigned to imported merchandise that has been left unclaimed and subsequently moved to a Customs bonded warehouse for storage.

values.name: Payer's financial institution account number
values.description: Originated company account number (ACH transfer), check, draft or wire.

values.name: Production code
values.description: Number assigned by the manufacturer to a specified article or batch to identify the manufacturing date etc. for subsequent reference.

values.name: Promotion deal number
values.description: Number assigned by a vendor to a special promotion activity.

values.name: Plant number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Prime contractor contract number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the client to the contract of the prime contractor.

values.name: Packing list number
values.description: (1014) Reference number assigned to a packing list, see: 1001 = 271.

values.name: Price list number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a price list.

values.name: Purchase order response number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the seller to an order response.

values.name: Purchase order change number
values.description: Reference number assigned by a buyer for a revision of a purchase order.

values.name: Payment reference
values.description: Reference number assigned to a payment.

values.name: Price quote number
values.description: Reference number assigned by the seller to a quote.

values.name: Purchase order number suffix
values.description: Purchase order number add on to split for detailed specification purposes.

values.name: Prior purchase order number
values.description: Reference number of a purchase order previously sent to the supplier.

values.name: Payee's financial institution account number
values.description: Receiving company account number (ACH transfer), check, draft or wire.

values.name: Rail/road routing code
values.description: International Western and Eastern European route code used in all rail organizations and specified in the international tariffs (rail tariffs) known by the customers.

values.name: Railway consignment note number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a rail consignment note, see: 1001 = 720.

values.name: Release number
values.description: Reference number assigned to identify a release of a set of rules, conventions, conditions, etc.

values.name: Received number
values.description: [1150] Number assigned to a rail consignment upon its arrival at its destination station (CIM 84).

values.name: Export reference number
values.description: Reference number given to an export shipment.

values.name: Payer's financial institution transit routing No.(ACH transfers)
values.description: ODFI (ACH transfer).

values.name: Payee's financial institution transit routing No.
values.description: RDFI Transit routing number (ACH transfer).

values.name: Sales person number
values.description: Identification number of a sales person.

values.name: Sales region number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Sales department number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Serial number
values.description: Identification number of an item which distinguishes this specific item out of an number of identical items.

values.name: Ship from
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Previous highest schedule number
values.description: Number of the latest schedule of a previous period (ODETTE DELINS).

values.name: SID (Shipper's identifying number for shipment)
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Sales office number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Seal number
values.description: [9308] Identification number on Customs or other seals affixed to containers or other transport units.

values.name: Scan line
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Container sequence number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Shipment reference number
values.description: [1140] Reference number assigned by a consignor to a particular shipment for his own purposes or for those of the consignee.

values.name: Sellers reference number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a transaction by the seller.

values.name: Station reference number
values.description: International UIC code assigned to every European rail station (CIM convention).

values.name: Swap order number
values.description: Number assigned by the seller to a swap order (see definition of DE 1001, code 229).

values.name: Specification number
values.description: Number assigned by the issuer to his specification.

values.name: Trucker's bill of lading
values.description: A cargo list/description issued by a motor carrier of freight.

values.name: Telex message number
values.description: Reference number identifying a telex message.

values.name: Transfer number
values.description: An extra number assigned to goods or a container which functions as a reference number or as an authorization number to get the goods or container released from a certain party.

values.name: TIR carnet number
values.description: Reference number assigned to a TIR carnet.

values.name: Tax exemption licence number
values.description: Number assigned by the tax authorities to a party indicating its tax exemption authorization. This number could relate to a specified business type, a specified local area or a class of products.

values.name: Transaction reference number
values.description: Reference applied to a transaction between two or more parties over a defined life cycle; e.g. number applied by importer or broker to obtain release from Customs, may then used to control declaration through final accounting (synonyms: declaration, entry number).

values.name: Test report number
values.description: Reference number identifying a test report document relevant to the product.

values.name: Upper serial number of range
values.description: Upper serial number in a range for declaration of incoming goods.

values.name: Ultimate customer's reference number
values.description: The originator's reference number as forwarded in a sequence of parties involved.

values.name: Unique consignment reference number
values.description: (1202) Unique reference of a consignment (UCRN) used for identification purposes in documents and messages exchanged between parties in international trade. See also: Unique Identifier Code (UNIC) in UN/ECE Recommendation No. 8, March 1992.

values.name: United Nations dangerous goods (UNDG) number
values.description: [7124] Unique serial number assigned within the United Nations to substances and articles contained in a list of the dangerous goods most commonly carried.

values.name: Ultimate customer's order number
values.description: The originator's order number as forwarded in a sequence of parties involved.

values.name: VAT registration number
values.description: Unique number assigned by the relevant tax authority to identify a party for use in relation to Value Added Tax (VAT).

values.name: Vendor contract number
values.description: Number assigned by the vendor to a contract.

values.name: Vessel identification
values.description: (8123) Reference identifying a vessel (UN/ECE Recommendation No 10).

values.name: Order number (vendor)
values.description: Reference number assigned by supplier to a buyer's purchase order.

values.name: Voyage number
values.description: [8228] Reference number assigned by the carrier or his agent to the voyage of the vessel.

values.name: Vendor product number
values.description: Number assigned by vendor to another manufacturer's product.

values.name: Vendor ID number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Vendor order number suffix
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Motor vehicle identification number
values.description: (Reference identifying a motor vehicle used for transport) normally is the vehicle registration number.

values.name: Voucher number
values.description: Reference number identifying a voucher.

values.name: Warehouse entry number
values.description: Entry number under which imported merchandise was placed in a Customs bonded warehouse.

values.name: Weight agreement number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Well number
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Company/place registration number
values.description: Company registration and place as legally required.

values.name: Cargo control number
values.description: Reference used to identify and control a carrier and consignment from initial entry into a country until release of the cargo by Customs.

values.name: Previous cargo control number
values.description: Where a consignment is deconsolidated and/or transferred to the control of another carrier or freight forwarder (e.g. housebill, abstract) this references the previous (e.g. master) cargo control number.

values.name: Mutually defined reference number
values.description: Number based on party agreement.
